title: May Bank Holiday silver jewellery sale 2026
description: The May Bank Holiday sale offered 20% off all silver jewellery, excluding collaborations and mixed-metal items. Mailing-list subscribers received VIP access on 1 May 2026. The sale opened to everyone on 2 May 2026 and ended at midnight GMT on 4 May 2026. It was available online and in stores.
source_reference: User statement describing the May Bank Holiday 2026 sale
